text:
maya: deploy-bot flagged the canary promotion as HOLD — artifact upload failed in the pipeline. logs show multipart upload errors (HTTP 503 / Broken pipe). anyone on-call?

deploy-bot: job 657421 failed during artifact push to registry (multipart upload). marking promotion hold. error snippet: `multipart upload part failed: status 503, retries exhausted`

liam: I'm looking. This is eu-west runner 12. Logs: `s3manager: upload part 3 -> HTTP 503`, then `write /var/lib/docker/tmp: broken pipe` a few seconds later. We've had high IO from docker layer prune earlier.

peter: sounds like concurrent GC + parallel multipart uploads caused S3 throttling. we've seen registry spikes when prune and many parallel pushes align.

jen: short-term unblock: pin image to the last successful digest and manually promote canary. longer term we should reduce parallel upload threads and add exponential backoff.

maya: can we get the digest? if sha256 matches prod-candidate we can pin and promote in the change window. need on-call approval.

olivia: I'm release on-call. I'll run the quick sha check. please paste the candidate digest.

liam: candidate digest: `sha256:abc123def4567890deadbeefcafebabe000111222333444555666777888999aaa` 
logs: `artifact size 1.2GB, upload parts 10, parallel 8`

peter: I verified the sha locally against the build artifact — matches. Agree to pin and manually promote to canary to avoid blocking the release. also recommend we bump upload timeout and lower parallelism. I'll open a follow-up PR.

deploy-bot: manual promote command available: `/deploy promote --env=canary --image=registry.redwood/v1.8.3@sha256:abc123def4567890deadbeefcafebabe000111222333444555666777888999aaa --reason="s3 throttle, manual promote"` 
note: command requires @olivia approval.

olivia: :thumbsup: approved. go ahead.

maya: running promote now. watching logs. please alert if any regressions.

deploy-bot: promotion started. streaming logs...

deploy-bot: promotion succeeded — canary updated to digest sha256:abc123def4567890deadbeefcafebabe000111222333444555666777888999aaa. monitoring for 10m.

jen: created follow-up ticket GH#7890 to limit parallel uploads, add retry/backoff, and add a small jitter before docker prune during heavy push windows.

peter: also adding a CI guard to reduce `MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS` when runner load > 70%.

liam: I restarted the flaky upload job with `MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS=2` and it completed. marking incident INC-4599 with notes.

maya: thanks all — unholding release. will schedule the longer fix PR for tomorrow's change window.
